idea-plugin.name: Cargo.toml Publish Gate
idea-plugin.description:
Names every crates.io publish blocker in a Cargo.toml before the upload burns a version number.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Cargo.toml Publish Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 13 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/cargo-publish-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/cargo-publish-gate

action.text: Cargo.toml Publish Gate: Check This File
action.description: Run Cargo.toml Publish Gate on the file in the editor
